HOME.fr: Un refuge perdu au cœur des montagnes norvégiennes

HOME.en: A remote Norwegian lodge. One week. A small group. Nature, movement and shared life.
HOME.fr: Un lodge norvégien isolé. Une semaine. Un petit groupe. La nature, le mouvement et la vie partagée.
HOME.da: En afsides norsk lodge. Én uge. En lille gruppe. Natur, bevægelse og fælles liv.

HOME.fr: La montagne se vit mieux ensemble

HOME.en: REFUGE61 sits above the treeline for those who come to move through the mountains by day and gather around the table by night.
HOME.fr: REFUGE61 est un refuge isolé dans les montagnes norvégiennes.La journée se passe dehors à parcourir les grands espaces, à pieds ou à skis. Le soir on se retrouve autour de la table.
HOME.da: REFUGE61 ligger over trægrænsen — for dem, der kommer for at bevæge sig gennem bjergene om dagen og samles om bordet om aftenen.

HOME.en: Each day begins outside. Ski, walk, explore — at your own pace, together with the group or alone. No programme to complete, no performance to prove. Just the pleasure of moving through a vast winter landscape.
HOME.fr: Chaque journée commence dehors. Skier, marcher, explorer — à votre rythme, avec le groupe ou seul. Aucun programme à suivre, aucune performance à prouver. Simplement le plaisir de traverser un vaste paysage d'hiver.
HOME.da: Hver dag begynder udenfor. Stå på ski, gå en tur, udforsk — i dit eget tempo, sammen med gruppen eller alene. Intet program, der skal gennemføres, ingen præstation, der skal bevises. Blot glæden ved at bevæge sig gennem et vidtstrakt vinterlandskab.

HOME.en: Life at REFUGE61 happens around the table. We cook together, share the meal, open a bottle, talk and laugh. There is no staff behind the scenes — everyone takes part in making the house come alive.
HOME.fr: La vie à REFUGE61 se déroule dans le chalet. Nous cuisinons ensemble, partageons le repas, ouvrons une bouteille, discutons et rions. Il n'y a pas de personnel en coulisses — chacun participe à faire vivre la maison.
HOME.da: Livet på REFUGE61 udspiller sig omkring bordet. Vi laver mad sammen, deler måltidet, åbner en flaske, taler og ler. Der er intet personale bag kulisserne — alle er med til at gøre huset levende.

HOME.fr: ralentir, décrocher, retrouver du temps pour autre chose.

HOME.en: A week away from schedules, noise and everyday routines. Time to slow down, read, sit by the fire, step outside or simply do nothing. Sometimes, a little distance is all we need.
HOME.fr: Une semaine loin des horaires, du bruit et des habitudes du quotidien. Le temps de ralentir, de lire, de s'asseoir près du feu, de sortir ou simplement de ne rien faire. Parfois, un peu de distance suffit.
HOME.da: En uge væk fra skemaer, støj og hverdagens rutiner. Tid til at sætte tempoet ned, læse, sidde ved ilden, gå udenfor eller simpelthen gøre ingenting. Nogle gange er lidt afstand alt, hvad vi har brug for.

HOME.fr: Certains jours, nous irons plus loin.
HOME.da: Nogle dage fører os længere ud.

HOME.en: When conditions allow, we leave the lodge for a longer journey into the mountains — on skis, on foot, carrying what we need for the day. Not a race and not a performance. Simply the pleasure of going somewhere together.
HOME.fr: Quand les conditions le permettent, nous quittons le lodge pour une plus longue échappée en montagne — à ski, à pied, en portant ce dont nous avons besoin pour la journée et la nuit. Ni course, ni performance. Simplement le plaisir d'aller quelque part ensemble.
HOME.da: Når forholdene tillader det, forlader vi lodgen for en længere tur ind i bjergene — på ski, til fods, med det vi har brug for til dagen. Ikke et kapløb og ikke en præstation. Blot glæden ved at tage et sted hen sammen.

HOME.en: Write to us, and we'll reply personally.
HOME.da: Skriv til os, så svarer vi personligt.

THE LODGE.en: THE LODGE
THE LODGE.fr: LE LODGE
THE LODGE.da: LODGEN

THE LODGE.en: A warm and comfortable home in the Norwegian mountains
THE LODGE.fr: Un chalet authentique et confortable dans les montagnes norvégiennes
THE LODGE.da: Et varmt og komfortabelt hjem i de norske bjerge

THE LODGE.en: For the week, the lodge will be our home — a place to relax, share meals and enjoy time together after a day in the mountains.
THE LODGE.fr: Le temps d'une semaine, le lodge sera notre maison — un lieu où se détendre, partager les repas et profiter d'être ensemble après une journée en montagne.
THE LODGE.da: I løbet af ugen bliver lodgen vores hjem — et sted at slappe af, dele måltider og nyde tiden sammen efter en dag i bjergene.

THE LODGE.en: The atmosphere is warm, authentic and relaxed — more a private mountain home than a hotel.
THE LODGE.fr: L'atmosphère y est chaleureuse, authentique et détendue — davantage une maison de montagne privée qu'un hôtel.
THE LODGE.da: Stemningen er varm, autentisk og afslappet — mere et privat bjerghjem end et hotel.

THE LODGE.en: A PLACE APART
THE LODGE.fr: UN LIEU À PART
THE LODGE.da: ET STED FOR SIG

THE LODGE.en: Set in the Norwegian mountains and surrounded by snow and nature, the lodge feels wonderfully removed from everyday life.
THE LODGE.fr: Ici, on se sent naturellement loin du quotidien.
THE LODGE.da: Beliggende i de norske bjerge og omgivet af sne og natur føles lodgen dejligt fjernt fra hverdagen.

THE LODGE.en: There are no crowds and no hotel corridors — just the silence of winter, open space and the feeling of having a mountain home to ourselves.
THE LODGE.fr: Ni foule, ni couloirs d'hôtel — seulement le silence de l'hiver, l'espace ouvert et le sentiment d'avoir une maison de montagne rien qu'à nous.
THE LODGE.da: Ingen menneskemængder og ingen hotelkorridorer — kun vinterens stilhed, det åbne landskab og fornemmelsen af at have et bjerghjem helt for os selv.

THE LODGE.en: THE ROOMS
THE LODGE.fr: LES CHAMBRES
THE LODGE.da: VÆRELSERNE

THE LODGE.en: Simple, comfortable and private
THE LODGE.fr: Simples, confortables et privées
THE LODGE.da: Enkle, komfortable og private

THE LODGE.en: Accommodation is arranged in comfortable rooms for a maximum of two people.
THE LODGE.fr: L'hébergement se fait en chambres confortables, pour deux personnes au maximum.
THE LODGE.da: Indkvarteringen sker i komfortable værelser med plads til højst to personer.

THE LODGE.en: There are no dormitories. Everyone has a proper room in which to rest and recharge after a day outside.
THE LODGE.fr: Il n'y a pas de dortoirs. Chacun dispose d'une vraie chambre où se reposer et récupérer après une journée dehors.
THE LODGE.da: Der er ingen sovesale. Alle har et rigtigt værelse, hvor man kan hvile og lade op efter en dag udendørs.

THE LODGE.en: The bedrooms are simple, warm and in keeping with the character of the lodge.
THE LODGE.fr: Les chambres sont simples, chaleureuses et fidèles au caractère du lodge.
THE LODGE.da: Værelserne er enkle, varme og i tråd med lodgens karakter.

THE LODGE.en: SAUNA & RELAXATION
THE LODGE.fr: SAUNA & DÉTENTE
THE LODGE.da: SAUNA & AFSLAPNING

THE LODGE.en: Warmth after the cold
THE LODGE.fr: La chaleur après le froid
THE LODGE.da: Varme efter kulden

THE LODGE.en: After a day in the snow, the sauna is the perfect place to slow down, warm up and relax.
THE LODGE.fr: Après une journée dans la neige, le sauna est l'endroit idéal pour ralentir, se réchauffer et se détendre.
THE LODGE.da: Efter en dag i sneen er saunaen det perfekte sted at falde til ro, blive varm og slappe af.

THE LODGE.en: And for those who want the full Nordic experience, step outside afterwards into the crisp winter air and snow — before heading back into the warmth.
THE LODGE.fr: Et pour ceux qui veulent l'expérience nordique complète, sortez ensuite dans l'air vif de l'hiver et la neige — avant de regagner la chaleur.
THE LODGE.da: Og for dem, der vil have den fulde nordiske oplevelse: gå bagefter ud i den skarpe vinterluft og sneen — før du vender tilbage til varmen.

THE LODGE.en: A simple ritual, and one of the pleasures of life in the Norwegian mountains.
THE LODGE.fr: Un rituel simple, et l'un des plaisirs de la vie dans les montagnes norvégiennes.
THE LODGE.da: Et enkelt ritual og en af glæderne ved livet i de norske bjerge.

THE LODGE.en: THE KITCHEN
THE LODGE.fr: LA CUISINE
THE LODGE.da: KØKKENET

THE LODGE.en: The pleasure of cooking together
THE LODGE.fr: Le plaisir de cuisiner ensemble
THE LODGE.da: Glæden ved at lave mad sammen

THE LODGE.en: The lodge has a large, fully equipped kitchen, designed for preparing meals together.
THE LODGE.fr: Le lodge dispose d'une grande cuisine entièrement équipée, conçue pour préparer les repas ensemble.
THE LODGE.da: Lodgen har et stort, fuldt udstyret køkken, indrettet til at lave mad sammen.

THE LODGE.en: Cooking is part of the experience — informal, convivial and shared. Some evenings we cook together, talk, have a drink and simply enjoy being there.
THE LODGE.fr: La cuisine fait partie de l'expérience : simple, conviviale et partagée. Le soir, nous cuisinons ensemble, discutons autour d'un verre et profitons simplement du moment.
THE LODGE.da: Madlavningen er en del af oplevelsen — uformel, hyggelig og fælles. Nogle aftener laver vi mad sammen, taler, får et glas og nyder blot at være der.

THE LODGE.en: AROUND THE TABLE
THE LODGE.fr: AUTOUR DE LA TABLE
THE LODGE.da: OMKRING BORDET

THE LODGE.en: The heart of the house
THE LODGE.fr: Le cœur de la maison
THE LODGE.da: Husets hjerte

THE LODGE.en: The large dining room is where everyone comes together.
THE LODGE.fr: La grande salle à manger est l'endroit où tout le monde se retrouve.
THE LODGE.da: Den store spisestue er der, hvor alle mødes.

THE LODGE.en: Breakfast before heading outside, dinner after a day in the snow, a bottle of wine, long conversations around the table — these shared moments are an important part of the week.
THE LODGE.fr: Un solide petit déjeuner avant de sortir, le dîner après une journée dans la neige, une bouteille de vin, de longues conversations autour de la table — ces moments partagés sont une part importante de la semaine.
THE LODGE.da: Morgenmad før man tager ud, aftensmad efter en dag i sneen, en flaske vin, lange samtaler omkring bordet — disse fælles stunder er en vigtig del af ugen.

THE LODGE.en: BY THE FIRE
THE LODGE.fr: AU COIN DU FEU
THE LODGE.da: VED PEJSEN

THE LODGE.en: When the day slows down
THE LODGE.fr: Quand la journée s'achève
THE LODGE.da: Når dagen falder til ro

THE LODGE.en: After skiing, snowshoeing or simply spending the day outdoors, there is nowhere better to end the day than around the fire.
THE LODGE.fr: Après le ski, les raquettes ou simplement une journée passée dehors, il n'y a pas de meilleure façon de finir la journée qu'autour du feu.
THE LODGE.da: Efter ski, snesko eller blot en dag udendørs findes der ingen bedre måde at slutte dagen på end omkring ilden.

THE LODGE.en: A drink, a book, a conversation — or simply doing nothing for a while.
THE LODGE.fr: Un verre, un livre, une conversation — ou simplement ne rien faire pendant un moment.
THE LODGE.da: Et glas, en bog, en samtale — eller blot at gøre ingenting et stykke tid.

THE LODGE.en: EVERYTHING WE NEED
THE LODGE.fr: TOUT CE DONT NOUS AVONS BESOIN
THE LODGE.da: ALT HVAD VI HAR BRUG FOR

THE LODGE.en: The lodge offers generous shared spaces, a fully equipped kitchen, a large dining room, comfortable living areas and everything we need to make it our home for the week.
THE LODGE.fr: Le lodge offre de généreux espaces communs, une cuisine entièrement équipée, une grande salle à manger, des pièces de vie confortables et tout ce qu'il faut pour en faire notre maison le temps d'une semaine.
THE LODGE.da: Lodgen har rummelige fællesarealer, et fuldt udstyret køkken, en stor spisestue, komfortable opholdsrum og alt, hvad der skal til for at gøre den til vores hjem i en uge.

THE LODGE.en: Simple does not mean basic.
THE LODGE.fr: Simple ne veut pas dire sommaire.
THE LODGE.da: Enkelt betyder ikke primitivt.

THE LODGE.en: The lodge is warm, comfortable and practical. What it deliberately does not offer is hotel service, passive consumption or a programme built around you.
THE LODGE.fr: Le lodge est chaleureux, confortable et pratique. Ce qu'il n'offre délibérément pas, c'est un service hôtelier, une consommation passive ou un programme organisé autour de vous.
THE LODGE.da: Lodgen er varm, komfortabel og praktisk. Det, den bevidst ikke tilbyder, er hotelservice, passivt forbrug eller et program bygget op omkring dig.

PRACTICAL INFO.da: Hvert ophold varer syv nætter.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: GETTING THERE
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: COMMENT VENIR
PRACTICAL INFO.da: SÅDAN KOMMER DU HERTIL

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Remote, but surprisingly easy to reach.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Loin de tout, mais facile d'accès.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Afsides, men overraskende let at nå.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Fly to Oslo Airport (Gardermoen). The railway station is located directly inside the airport.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Venez en train ou en avion jusqu'à l'aéroport d'Oslo (Gardermoen) . La gare se trouve directement dans l'aéroport.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Flyv til Oslo Lufthavn (Gardermoen). Togstationen ligger inde i selve lufthavnen.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Direct trains on the Dovre Line run north from Oslo Airport to Vinstra, with a journey time of approximately three hours.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Des trains directs de la ligne Dovre relient l'aéroport d'Oslo à Vinstra vers le nord, en trois heures environ.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Direkte tog på Dovrebanen kører nordpå fra Oslo Lufthavn til Vinstra med en rejsetid på cirka tre timer.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: We will meet you at Vinstra station and take you the rest of the way to REFUGE61.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Nous vous accueillerons à la gare de Vinstra et vous conduirons jusqu'à REFUGE61.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Vi møder dig på Vinstra station og kører dig det sidste stykke til REFUGE61.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: We will provide recommended train times for each REFUGE61 week before your journey.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Nous vous communiquerons les horaires de train recommandés pour chaque semaine REFUGE61 avant votre voyage.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Vi sender anbefalede togtider for hver REFUGE61-uge inden din rejse.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: No need to travel into Oslo. No car is needed.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Inutile de passer par Oslo. Aucune voiture n'est nécessaire.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Du behøver ikke tage ind til Oslo. Der er ikke brug for bil.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: THE LODGE
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: LE LODGE
PRACTICAL INFO.da: LODGEN

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Simple, warm and comfortable.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Simple, chaleureux et confortable.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Enkel, varm og komfortabel.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: The lodge is made for shared living. Bedrooms are for two people, with a washbasin in each room. Toilets are available on every floor.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Le lodge est conçu pour la vie en commun. Les chambres accueillent deux personnes et disposent chacune d'un lavabo. Des toilettes sont disponibles à chaque étage.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Lodgen er indrettet til fælles liv. Værelserne er til to personer med håndvask på hvert værelse. Der er toiletter på hver etage.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Showers and the sauna are in a separate building, just a few metres from the main lodge.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Les douches et le sauna se trouvent dans un bâtiment séparé, à quelques mètres seulement du lodge principal.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Bad og sauna ligger i en separat bygning, blot få meter fra hovedbygningen.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Bed linen and towels are provided.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Draps et serviettes sont fournis.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Sengelinned og håndklæder stilles til rådighed.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: MEALS
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: LES REPAS
PRACTICAL INFO.da: MÅLTIDERNE

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Around the same table.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Autour de la même table.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Omkring det samme bord.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Meals are part of the REFUGE61 experience. We prepare, cook and eat together, with small teams naturally taking turns in the kitchen.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Les repas font partie de l'expérience REFUGE61. Nous préparons les repas et mangeons ensemble. De petites équipes se relaient naturellement en cuisine.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Måltiderne er en del af REFUGE61-oplevelsen. Vi forbereder, laver mad og spiser sammen, hvor små hold naturligt skiftes til at stå i køkkenet.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: There is no restaurant and no room service. Participation is part of what makes the week different.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Il n'y a ni restaurant ni service en chambre. La participation fait partie de ce qui rend la semaine différente.Mais le ménage sera fait après votre départ.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Der er ingen restaurant og ingen roomservice. Deltagelsen er en del af det, der gør ugen anderledes.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: SKI FROM THE DOOR
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: On chausse les skis à la porte du chalet
PRACTICAL INFO.da: PÅ SKI FRA DØREN

PRACTICAL INFO.en: 650 kilometres of tracks. Twenty metres from the lodge.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: 650 kilomètres de pistes. À vingt mètres du lodge.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: 650 kilometer spor. Tyve meter fra lodgen.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Just 20 metres from REFUGE61, you can step onto a groomed cross-country ski trail, prepared for both classic and skating.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: À seulement 20 mètres de REFUGE61, vous accédez à un réseau de pistes de ski de fond damée, préparée pour le classique comme pour le skating.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Kun 20 meter fra REFUGE61 kan du træde ud på et præpareret langrendsspor, klargjort til både klassisk og skøjting.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: From there, the trail connects to a network of around 650 kilometres of cross-country ski tracks.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: De là, la piste rejoint un réseau d'environ 650 kilomètres de pistes de ski de fond.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Derfra forbinder sporet til et net på omkring 650 kilometer langrendsspor.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: No transfer. No car. No timetable. Just put on your skis and go — with others or alone, for an hour or for the day.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Aucun transfert. Aucune voiture. Aucun horaire. Chaussez vos raquettes ou vos skis et partez — accompagné ou seul, pour une heure ou pour la journée.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Ingen transfer. Ingen bil. Ingen tidsplan. Tag blot skiene på og kom afsted — sammen med andre eller alene, i en time eller hele dagen.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: A TYPICAL DAY
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: UNE JOURNÉE TYPE
PRACTICAL INFO.da: EN TYPISK DAG

PRACTICAL INFO.en: There isn’t really one.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Il n'y en a pas vraiment.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Den findes ikke rigtigt.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: There is no timetable to follow. We have breakfast, look outside, talk about the weather and snow conditions — and decide.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Il n'y a pas d'horaire à suivre. Nous prenons le petit-déjeuner, regardons dehors, parlons de la météo et de l'état de la neige — puis nous décidons.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Der er ingen tidsplan at følge. Vi spiser morgenmad, kigger ud, taler om vejret og sneforholdene — og beslutter os.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Some may ski together, others may head out alone. The important thing is to be outside, move and enjoy the landscape at your own rhythm.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Certains skieront ensemble, d'autres partiront seuls. L'essentiel est d'être dehors, de bouger et de profiter du paysage à son propre rythme.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Nogle står måske på ski sammen, andre tager afsted alene. Det vigtige er at være ude, bevæge sig og nyde landskabet i sit eget tempo.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Later, we come back to the lodge, cook together and gather around the table.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Plus tard, nous rentrons au lodge, cuisinons ensemble et nous retrouvons autour de la table.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Senere vender vi tilbage til lodgen, laver mad sammen og samles om bordet.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: THE EXPEDITION
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: L'EXPÉDITION
PRACTICAL INFO.da: EKSPEDITIONEN

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Beyond the lodge.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Au-delà du lodge.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Ud over lodgen.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: During the week, when weather and snow conditions allow, we plan an optional expedition into the mountains, with the possibility of spending a night away.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Durant la semaine, lorsque la météo et l'état de la neige le permettent, nous organisons une expédition facultative en montagne, avec la possibilité de passer une nuit dehors.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: I løbet af ugen planlægger vi — når vejr- og sneforhold tillader det — en frivillig ekspedition ind i bjergene, med mulighed for en overnatning.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Taking part is entirely your choice. Those who prefer to stay at the lodge or enjoy a different activity are completely free to do so.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Rien n’est imposé. Vous pouvez participer, rester au lodge ou simplement organiser votre journée comme vous en avez envie.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Deltagelse er helt frivillig. De, der foretrækker at blive på lodgen eller lave noget andet, er helt frit stillet.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: The expedition is not a race or a test of performance. It is simply an opportunity to go further, carry what we need and experience the winter landscape differently.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: L'expédition n'est ni une course ni un test de performance. C'est simplement l'occasion d'aller plus loin, de porter ce dont on a besoin et de découvrir le paysage hivernal autrement.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Ekspeditionen er hverken et kapløb eller en præstationstest. Det er blot en mulighed for at komme længere ud, bære det vi har brug for og opleve vinterlandskabet på en anden måde.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: FITNESS & EXPERIENCE
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: FORME & EXPÉRIENCE
PRACTICAL INFO.da: FORM & ERFARING

PRACTICAL INFO.en: Active, not extreme.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Actif, sans être extrême.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Aktiv, ikke ekstrem.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: You don’t need to be an athlete. But you should enjoy being outside, moving and spending several hours in a winter environment.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Nul besoin d'être un athlète. Mais il faut aimer être dehors, bouger et passer plusieurs heures dans un environnement hivernal.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Du behøver ikke være atlet. Men du skal kunne lide at være udendørs, bevæge dig og tilbringe flere timer i et vintermiljø.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: REFUGE61 is about finding your own rhythm — sometimes with the group, sometimes alone.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: REFUGE61, c'est trouver son propre rythme — parfois avec le groupe, parfois seul.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: REFUGE61 handler om at finde sit eget tempo — nogle gange sammen med gruppen, nogle gange alene.

PRACTICAL INFO.en: It is neither a training camp nor a week spent entirely indoors.
PRACTICAL INFO.fr: Ce n'est ni un stage d'entraînement ni une semaine passée entièrement à l'intérieur.
PRACTICAL INFO.da: Det er hverken en træningslejr eller en uge tilbragt helt indendørs.

LET'S TALK.en: BJØRN JACOB HAUGUM
LET'S TALK.da: BJØRN JACOB HAUGUM

LET'S TALK.en: I’m Bjørn Jacob Haugum – an outdoor guide, ultrarunner and entrepreneur with a passion for creating adventures and experiences for others.
LET'S TALK.fr: Je suis Bjørn Jacob Haugum – guide Outdoor, ultra-traileur et entrepreneur. J’aime avant tout faire découvrir la nature et partager avec les autres les aventures et les expériences qui me passionnent.
LET'S TALK.da: Jeg hedder Bjørn Jacob Haugum – friluftsguide, ultraløber og iværksætter med en passion for at skabe eventyr og oplevelser for andre.

LET'S TALK.en: Through Bjørnen i bjergene and REFUGE61°, I create outdoor experiences that bring people closer to nature, to each other and to themselves. I have spent my whole life exploring the outdoors across the Nordic countries and feel particularly at home in winter landscapes.
LET'S TALK.fr: À travers Bjørnen i bjergene et REFUGE61°, je crée des expériences en plein air qui rapprochent les gens de la nature, des autres et d'eux-mêmes. J'ai passé toute ma vie à explorer les pays nordiques et je me sens particulièrement chez moi dans les paysages d'hiver.
LET'S TALK.da: Gennem Bjørnen i bjergene og REFUGE61° skaber jeg friluftsoplevelser, der bringer mennesker tættere på naturen, på hinanden og på sig selv. Jeg har brugt hele mit liv på at udforske naturen i Norden og føler mig især hjemme i vinterlandskaber.

LET'S TALK.en: I’m driven by creating the setting for truly memorable experiences in nature – and making them accessible to others.
LET'S TALK.fr: Ce qui m'anime, c'est de créer le cadre d'expériences véritablement mémorables dans la nature – et de les rendre accessibles à d'autres.
LET'S TALK.da: Det, der driver mig, er at skabe rammerne for virkelig mindeværdige oplevelser i naturen – og gøre dem tilgængelige for andre.

LET'S TALK.en: MATHIEU BONNIER
LET'S TALK.da: MATHIEU BONNIER

LET'S TALK.en: I’m Mathieu Bonnier – an entrepreneur and lifelong outdoor enthusiast, with a particular love for winter, snow and remote places.
LET'S TALK.fr: Je suis Mathieu Bonnier — entrepreneur et passionné de plein air depuis toujours, avec un goût particulier pour l'hiver, la neige et les endroits isolés.
LET'S TALK.da: Jeg hedder Mathieu Bonnier – iværksætter og friluftsentusiast hele livet, med en særlig forkærlighed for vinteren, sneen og afsides steder.

LET'S TALK.en: For me, adventure is not about performance or going further than anyone else. It is about being outdoors, discovering new places, living simply and sharing good moments with the people around me.That is the spirit I hope to bring to REFUGE61°.
LET'S TALK.fr: Pour moi, l'aventure n'est pas une question de performance ou d'aller plus loin que les autres. C'est avant tout être dehors, découvrir de nouveaux endroits, vivre simplement et partager de bons moments. C'est cet esprit que j'ai envie d'apporter à REFUGE61°.
LET'S TALK.da: For mig handler eventyr ikke om præstation eller om at komme længere end alle andre. Det handler om at være udendørs, opdage nye steder, leve enkelt og dele gode stunder med menneskene omkring mig. Det er den ånd, jeg håber at bringe til REFUGE61°.

LET'S TALK.en: TOGETHER
LET'S TALK.da: SAMMEN

LET'S TALK.en: We come from different backgrounds and generations, but we share the same idea of what makes an adventure memorable: nature, simplicity, freedom and people.
LET'S TALK.fr: Nous venons d'horizons et de générations différentes, mais nous partageons la même idée de ce qui rend une aventure mémorable : la nature, la simplicité, la liberté et les gens.
LET'S TALK.da: Vi kommer fra forskellige baggrunde og generationer, men vi deler den samme opfattelse af, hvad der gør et eventyr mindeværdigt: natur, enkelhed, frihed og mennesker.

LET'S TALK.da: REFUGE61° er vokset ud af den fælles vision.

LET'S TALK.da: REFUGE61° er vokset ud af den fælles vision. Det handler ikke om at følge et program eller sætte flueben.

LET'S TALK.en: It is about living together for a few days in a special place, getting outside, sharing meals and experiences, and enjoying the rhythm of winter in the Norwegian mountains.
LET'S TALK.fr: Il s'agit de vivre ensemble quelques jours dans un lieu particulier, de sortir, de partager les repas et les expériences, et de profiter du rythme de l'hiver dans les montagnes norvégiennes.
LET'S TALK.da: Det handler om at leve sammen i nogle dage på et særligt sted, komme udenfor, dele måltider og oplevelser og nyde vinterens rytme i de norske bjerge.

LET'S TALK.en: With REFUGE61°, we want to create the kind of week we would personally love to experience: simple, active and authentic, with time outdoors, good food, shared moments and the freedom to enjoy the mountains at your own pace.
LET'S TALK.fr: Avec REFUGE61°, nous voulons créer le genre de semaine que nous aimerions nous-mêmes vivre : simple, active et authentique, avec du temps dehors, de la bonne nourriture, des moments partagés et la liberté de profiter de la montagne à son propre rythme.
LET'S TALK.da: Med REFUGE61° vil vi skabe den slags uge, vi selv ville elske at opleve: enkel, aktiv og autentisk, med tid udendørs, god mad, fælles stunder og friheden til at nyde bjergene i sit eget tempo.

LET'S TALK.da: Hvem er REFUGE61 for?

LET'S TALK.en: REFUGE61 is primarily designed for active adults over 50 who enjoy nature, movement and shared experiences. You don’t need to be an athlete — curiosity, independence and the right mindset matter much more than performance.
LET'S TALK.fr: REFUGE61 est conçu avant tout pour des adultes actifs de plus de 50 ans qui aiment la nature, le mouvement et les expériences partagées. Nul besoin d'être un athlète — la curiosité, l'autonomie et l'état d'esprit comptent bien plus que la performance.
LET'S TALK.da: REFUGE61 er primært til aktive voksne over 50 år, som holder af natur, bevægelse og fælles oplevelser. Du behøver ikke være atlet — nysgerrighed, selvstændighed og den rette indstilling betyder langt mere end præstation.

LET'S TALK.en: Do I need to be a good skier?
LET'S TALK.da: Skal jeg være en god skiløber?

LET'S TALK.en: No. You should enjoy being active outdoors, but REFUGE61 is not a training camp. Everyone is free to find their own rhythm, sometimes with the group and sometimes alone.
LET'S TALK.fr: Non. Il faut aimer être actif en plein air, mais REFUGE61 n'est pas un stage d'entraînement. Chacun est libre de trouver son propre rythme, parfois avec le groupe, parfois seul.
LET'S TALK.da: Nej. Du skal kunne lide at være aktiv udendørs, men REFUGE61 er ikke en træningslejr. Alle er frit stillet til at finde deres eget tempo, nogle gange sammen med gruppen og nogle gange alene.

LET'S TALK.en: Do I need to bring my own skis?
LET'S TALK.da: Skal jeg medbringe mine egne ski?

LET'S TALK.en: If you regularly practise cross-country skiing, we recommend bringing your own skis, boots and poles. You will probably be more comfortable using equipment you already know. If you don’t have your own equipment, Nordic skis, boots and poles will be available at REFUGE61 for the duration of the week.
LET'S TALK.fr: Si vous pratiquez régulièrement le ski de fond, nous vous conseillons d'apporter vos propres skis, chaussures et bâtons. Vous serez sans doute plus à l'aise avec un matériel que vous connaissez déjà. Si vous n'avez pas votre propre équipement, des skis nordiques, des chaussures et des bâtons seront disponibles à REFUGE61 pendant toute la semaine.
LET'S TALK.da: Hvis du jævnligt står på langrend, anbefaler vi, at du tager dine egne ski, støvler og stave med. Du vil sandsynligvis være mere tilpas med udstyr, du allerede kender. Har du ikke dit eget udstyr, står langrendsski, støvler og stave til rådighed på REFUGE61 i hele ugen.

LET'S TALK.en: Do we have to do everything together?
LET'S TALK.da: Skal vi lave alting sammen?

LET'S TALK.en: No. We live together, but that doesn’t mean doing everything together. You are free to join the group or spend time on your own.
LET'S TALK.fr: Non. Nous vivons ensemble, mais cela ne veut pas dire tout faire ensemble. Vous êtes libre de vous joindre au groupe ou de prendre du temps pour vous.
LET'S TALK.da: Nej. Vi bor sammen, men det betyder ikke, at vi laver alting sammen. Du er fri til at slutte dig til gruppen eller bruge tid for dig selv.

LET'S TALK.en: Where can we ski?
LET'S TALK.da: Hvor kan vi stå på ski?

LET'S TALK.en: A groomed cross-country ski trail passes just 20 metres from the lodge, prepared for both classic and skating. It connects directly to a network of around 650 kilometres of trails. You can simply put on your skis and go.
LET'S TALK.fr: Une piste de ski de fond damée passe à seulement 20 mètres du lodge, préparée pour le classique comme pour le skating. Elle rejoint directement un réseau d'environ 650 kilomètres de pistes. Il suffit de chausser vos skis et de partir.
LET'S TALK.da: Et præpareret langrendsspor går blot 20 meter fra lodgen, klargjort til både klassisk og skøjting. Det forbinder direkte til et net på omkring 650 kilometer spor. Du tager blot skiene på og kører.

LET'S TALK.en: Do I have to join the mini-expedition?
LET'S TALK.da: Skal jeg deltage i mini-ekspeditionen?

LET'S TALK.en: No. The expedition is entirely optional. When conditions allow, we may organise a longer journey into the mountains, possibly including a night away. Those who prefer to stay at the lodge or do something different are completely free to do so.
LET'S TALK.fr: Non. L'expédition est entièrement facultative. Lorsque les conditions le permettent, nous pouvons organiser une plus longue échappée en montagne, éventuellement avec une nuit dehors. Ceux qui préfèrent rester au lodge ou faire autre chose en sont tout à fait libres.
LET'S TALK.da: Nej. Ekspeditionen er helt frivillig. Når forholdene tillader det, arrangerer vi måske en længere tur ind i bjergene, eventuelt med en overnatning. De, der foretrækker at blive på lodgen eller lave noget andet, er helt frit stillet.

LET'S TALK.en: Do guests participate in preparing meals?
LET'S TALK.fr: Les hôtes participent-ils à la préparation des repas ?
LET'S TALK.da: Deltager gæsterne i madlavningen?

LET'S TALK.en: Yes. We prepare, cook and eat together, with small teams naturally taking turns in the kitchen. Participation is part of the experience.
LET'S TALK.fr: Oui. Nous préparons, cuisinons et mangeons ensemble, de petites équipes se relayant naturellement en cuisine. La participation fait partie de l'expérience.
LET'S TALK.da: Ja. Vi forbereder, laver mad og spiser sammen, hvor små hold naturligt skiftes til at stå i køkkenet. Deltagelsen er en del af oplevelsen.

LET'S TALK.en: What are the bedrooms like?
LET'S TALK.da: Hvordan er værelserne?

LET'S TALK.en: Bedrooms are for two people. Toilets are available on every floor. Showers and the sauna are in a separate building just a few metres away. Bed linen and towels are provided.
LET'S TALK.fr: Les chambres accueillent deux personnes. Des toilettes sont disponibles à chaque étage. Les douches et le sauna se trouvent dans un bâtiment séparé, à quelques mètres seulement. Draps et serviettes sont fournis.
LET'S TALK.da: Værelserne er til to personer. Der er toiletter på hver etage. Bad og sauna ligger i en separat bygning blot få meter væk. Sengelinned og håndklæder stilles til rådighed.

LET'S TALK.en: How do I get to REFUGE61?
LET'S TALK.da: Hvordan kommer jeg til REFUGE61?

LET'S TALK.en: Fly to Oslo Airport (Gardermoen). The railway station is directly inside the airport. Direct trains run north to Vinstra, in less than 3 hours, where we will meet our guests and take them the rest of the way to REFUGE61.
LET'S TALK.fr: Prenez l'avion ou le train jusqu'à l'aéroport d'Oslo (Gardermoen). La gare se trouve directement dans l'aéroport. Des trains directs rejoignent Vinstra vers le nord en moins de 3 heures ; nous y accueillons nos hôtes et les conduisons jusqu'à REFUGE61.
LET'S TALK.da: Flyv til Oslo Lufthavn (Gardermoen). Togstationen ligger inde i selve lufthavnen. Direkte tog kører nordpå til Vinstra på under 3 timer, hvor vi møder vores gæster og kører dem det sidste stykke til REFUGE61.

LET'S TALK.en: What does a stay cost?
LET'S TALK.da: Hvad koster et ophold?

LET'S TALK.en: €1,800 per person for seven nights, including accommodation, meals at the lodge, bed linen and towels, and Nordic skiing equipment for the week.
LET'S TALK.fr: 1 800 € par personne pour sept nuits, comprenant l'hébergement, les repas au lodge, les draps et serviettes, ainsi que le matériel de ski nordique pour la semaine.
LET'S TALK.da: 1.800 € pr. person for syv nætter, inklusive indkvartering, måltider på lodgen, sengelinned og håndklæder samt langrendsudstyr for hele ugen.

LET'S TALK.en: How do I reserve a place?
LET'S TALK.da: Hvordan reserverer jeg en plads?

LET'S TALK.en: There is no online booking. Complete the LET’S TALK questionnaire and Bjorn or Mathieu will contact you personally. If REFUGE61 feels right for everyone, we will then explain how to confirm your place.
LET'S TALK.fr: Il n'y a pas de réservation en ligne. Remplissez le questionnaire PARLONS-EN et Bjorn ou Mathieu vous contactera personnellement. Si REFUGE61 convient à chacun, nous vous expliquerons ensuite comment confirmer votre place.
LET'S TALK.da: Der er ingen onlinebooking. Udfyld LAD OS TALE SAMMEN-spørgeskemaet, så kontakter Bjorn eller Mathieu dig personligt. Hvis REFUGE61 føles rigtigt for alle, forklarer vi derefter, hvordan du bekræfter din plads.

TERMS.en: TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF TRAVEL
REFUGE61°
BACK TO BASICS
1. About REFUGE61
REFUGE61 is a one-week winter experience in the Norwegian mountains, centred around cross-country skiing, nature, simplicity, community and life in a mountain lodge.
The stay runs from Saturday to Saturday.

REFUGE61 is neither a traditional hotel stay nor a classic guided ski holiday with a fixed daily programme. Guests and hosts live together at the lodge, share meals, cook together and spend their days cross-country skiing and enjoying the winter landscape.

Guests are free to choose their own pace and activities. The hosts provide the framework for the week, advise on routes and possibilities, share practical tips on cross-country skiing and join selected outings.The week also includes the opportunity to take part in an optional mini-expedition, with one overnight stay in the winter mountains, subject to weather, snow and safety conditions.

2. Duration and Accommodation
The specific dates are stated in the individual booking.
The lodge has seven double rooms and accommodates up to 14 guests.
Accommodation is normally based on two guests sharing a room.
Solo travellers booking shared accommodation may be paired with another solo traveller. The applicable room arrangement will be made clear to the guest before the booking becomes binding.
A private room may be booked for an additional charge, subject to availability.
3. What Is Included
The price includes:
accommodation at the lodge
breakfast, lunch and dinner
transport from Vinstra station to the lodge on arrival
transport from the lodge to Vinstra station on departure
nordic cross-country skis
ski boots
ski poles
relevant shared equipment for the mini-expedition
activities during the stay
mini-expedition with one overnight stay
bed linen
towels
bathrobe.
Transport to and from Vinstra is not included.
Guests must bring their own winter and ski clothing, ordinary clothing and footwear, personal medication and snacks.
Beer, wine and other alcoholic beverages are not included. Guests may bring their own alcohol for moderate personal consumption.
4. Arrival and Departure
Guests are responsible for arranging their own transport to and from Vinstra.
Before the trip, REFUGE61 will provide a recommended arrival time at Vinstra station. The shared transfer to the lodge is organised on the basis of this time.
If a guest cannot arrive at the recommended time, alternative arrangements must be agreed with REFUGE61 in advance.
The same principle applies on departure. REFUGE61 will provide a recommended departure time and arrange transport from the lodge to Vinstra station.
Individual arrangements may be possible where practical.
5. Meals and Shared Life
Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included.
REFUGE61 is a shared experience rather than a traditional hotel stay. Preparing food, eating together and taking part in everyday life at the lodge are part of the concept.
Guests are divided into small cooking teams of approximately three people. As a general rule, each team prepares one dinner and one breakfast during the week.
We provide varied food and aim to offer sufficient choice for everyone to eat well.
REFUGE61 does not normally prepare individual meals or separate menus tailored to specific dietary preferences or diets.

Guests must inform REFUGE61 before the stay of any food allergy or dietary requirement that is important for us to know about. Guests with particular dietary needs are encouraged to contact us before booking so that the practical possibilities can be clarified.
6. Booking and Payment
A deposit of 25% of the total price is payable at the time of booking.
The remaining 75% must be paid no later than 60 days before the start of the trip.
If the trip is booked less than 60 days before departure, the full price is payable at the time of booking.
The booking becomes binding once REFUGE61 has received the required payment and the guest has received a booking confirmation.
By booking, the guest accepts these Terms and Conditions of Travel.
7. Cancellation by the Guest
The guest may cancel the trip at any time before departure.
The following standard cancellation fees apply:
More than 90 days before departureNo cancellation fee. All amounts paid are refunded.
90 to 61 days before departureCancellation fee: 25% of the total price.
60 to 15 days before departureCancellation fee: 50% of the total price.
14 days or less before departureCancellation fee: 100% of the total price.
If the guest has paid more than the applicable cancellation fee, REFUGE61 will refund the difference.
Any refund will be made without undue delay and no later than 14 days after cancellation.
Cancellation must be notified to REFUGE61 in writing.
The standard cancellation fees are subject to mandatory package travel legislation. If mandatory law gives the guest a greater right to reimbursement, the statutory rules take precedence.
8. Illness and Personal Circumstances
Illness, injury, changes in employment circumstances or other personal circumstances affecting the guest do not in themselves alter the ordinary cancellation terms.
REFUGE61 therefore strongly recommends appropriate cancellation insurance.
9. Transfer of the Trip
If a guest is unable to participate, the trip may be transferred to another person who fulfils the conditions for participation, in accordance with the Danish Package Travel Act.
REFUGE61 must be informed on a durable medium as early as possible before departure.
Notification received no later than seven days before the start of the trip is considered to have been given within a reasonable time under the Danish Package Travel Act.
REFUGE61 may charge the actual, documented and reasonable costs arising directly from the transfer.
The original guest and the person taking over the trip remain responsible for outstanding payments and transfer-related costs to the extent provided by law.
10. Insurance
It is a condition of participation in REFUGE61 that the guest has relevant and adequate insurance throughout the journey and stay.
As a minimum, the insurance must cover:
illness
accident
necessary medical treatment and repatriation
the winter, skiing and outdoor activities in which the guest intends to participate.

The guest is responsible for ensuring that the insurance applies to the activities included in the stay, including cross-country skiing and the mini-expedition with an overnight stay in the winter mountains.
As part of the booking process, the guest will be asked to confirm that they understand and accept this insurance requirement and that adequate insurance will be in place before departure.
REFUGE61 recommends that the guest's insurance also includes cancellation cover.
REFUGE61 maintains relevant business and liability insurance for its own activities.
11. Cross-Country Skiing and Activities
REFUGE61 does not provide formal cross-country skiing instruction.
The hosts share experience and practical tips, advise on routes and conditions and join selected outings.
Guests decide for themselves which activities and outings they wish to take part in. There is no expectation that everyone follows the same programme or pace.

Previous cross-country skiing experience is not required, but guests should be in normal physical condition and are responsible for assessing whether a chosen activity is appropriate for their own physical and technical ability.
12. Independent Outings and Safety
Guests are generally free to organise their own days and may go on ski outings without the hosts.
For safety reasons, guests going out independently are strongly encouraged to inform the hosts or another person at the lodge of their planned route and expected return time.
Each guest is responsible for choosing an outing appropriate to their own ability and the conditions on the day.
REFUGE61 may recommend or advise against particular routes or activities based on weather, snow conditions, safety or other relevant circumstances.
Cross-country skiing and travel in the winter mountains involve inherent risks. These inherent risks do not in themselves constitute a lack of conformity in the package.
REFUGE61 remains responsible for the performance of the agreed travel services and for injury or loss to the extent required by applicable law.
Nothing in these terms excludes or limits any liability or right that cannot legally be excluded or restricted to the detriment of the guest.
13. The Mini-Expedition
During the week, guests are offered a mini-expedition with one overnight stay in the winter mountains.
Participation is voluntary.
The mini-expedition takes place together with the hosts and is facilitated by REFUGE61. Relevant shared expedition equipment is provided.
The route, timing, overnight location and final format depend on the prevailing weather, temperature, snow and safety conditions.
The hosts may therefore change the route, timing or activity or, where necessary, decide that the mini-expedition cannot take place as originally planned.
14. Weather and Changes to the Programme
REFUGE61 takes place in the winter mountains, where changing weather and snow conditions are part of the experience.
Specific routes, snow conditions or activities on particular days therefore cannot be guaranteed.
Minor changes to routes, activities and the practical programme may be made where circumstances require, particularly for reasons of weather, snow conditions or safety.
If a change constitutes a significant change to an agreed travel service or a lack of conformity in the package, the traveller's rights under applicable package travel legislation apply.
15. Age and Conduct
Guests must normally be at least 18 years old to participate independently.
Young people aged 16 or over may participate when accompanied by a responsible adult.
REFUGE61 is based on community, freedom, trust and mutual respect. Guests are expected to behave responsibly and considerately towards other guests, the hosts, the lodge and nature.
The lodge and surrounding area are smoke-free.
Alcohol may be consumed in moderation and with due consideration for the community, safety and planned activities.
16. Equipment
Included ski and expedition equipment is made available to guests during the stay.
Guests are expected to treat the equipment responsibly and follow reasonable instructions concerning its use.
Ordinary wear and tear and accidental damage do not in themselves give rise to a compensation claim against the guest.
In cases of intentional damage or damage caused by grossly irresponsible treatment, the guest may be held liable for the documented loss in accordance with applicable law.
17. Cancellation by REFUGE61
REFUGE61 operates the trip regardless of the number of guests booked. There is no minimum participant requirement.
If REFUGE61 cancels the entire trip, all amounts paid by the guest to REFUGE61 will be refunded without undue delay and no later than 14 days after cancellation.
The guest's remaining rights are governed by applicable package travel legislation.
Illness or absence of one of the hosts does not in itself result in cancellation if the stay can still be carried out safely and properly with the other host.
18. Unavoidable and Extraordinary Circumstances
The rules of the Danish Package Travel Act apply in the event of unavoidable and extraordinary circumstances.

If such circumstances at the destination or in its immediate vicinity significantly affect the performance of the package or the transport of passengers to the destination, the guest has the cancellation, refund and other rights provided by applicable law.
19. Travel Guarantee Fund, Travel Documents and Problems During the Stay
Before selling and operating trips for which registration is required, REFUGE61 will be registered with the Danish Travel Guarantee Fund (Rejsegarantifonden).
Once registration is complete, the relevant registration details will be inserted here.
Guests are responsible for holding a valid passport and any other necessary travel documents.
Before the contract is concluded, REFUGE61 will provide any passport, visa and health information that the organiser is legally required to provide.

If a problem arises during the stay, the guest must contact REFUGE61 or the hosts as soon as reasonably possible so that REFUGE61 has the opportunity to investigate and, where possible, remedy the problem.
The guest's statutory rights remain unaffected.
20. Governing Law and Contact
The trip is organised by a Danish company and is governed by Danish law.
Where the trip is subject to the Danish Act on Package Travel and Linked Travel Arrangements, its mandatory provisions apply regardless of the wording of these terms.
The choice of Danish law does not limit any protection available to a consumer under mandatory rules applicable to the contract.
